title: Modeling Dynamic User Interests: A Neural Matrix Factorization Approach
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Neural matrix factorization model of evolving user interests from text consumption data.
design_notes: submit_code/code_final.py (PyTorch): learns dynamic user weights and content attributes; cosine similarity and k-nearest-neighbour evaluation on a held-out period.
data_files_note: readme.txt: 'A simulated sample of 500 users content consumption over time'; full data under NDA.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
